items.name: arc_ptr_eq
items.summary: Compares two `Arc` pointers for equality based on their underlying pointers values. This is not equivalent to [`Arc::ptr_eq`] for fat pointers, see that method for more information.

items.name: arc_ptr_hash
items.summary: Hashes an `Arc` pointer based on its underlying pointer value. The general contract for this function is that if [`arc_ptr_eq`] returns `true` for two `Arc`s, then this function should return the same hash value for both.

items.name: PtrEq
items.summary: A wrapper around a pointer that implements `Eq` and `Hash` comparing the underlying pointer address.
